judgments.catchwords: Having considered the affidavits, submissions, and authorities placed before me, and applying the governing principles on stays of execution, I am satisfied that the Appellants have not established any special circumstance that would justify suspending the execution of a monetary judgment already affirmed by this Court. Their concerns regarding liability fall outside the stay framework; their apprehension of non repayment is unsupported by evidence; their prejudice argument is speculative; and their status quo ground is procedurally inadmissible. The Respondent’s prejudice, by contrast, is real, continuing, and compounded by delay. For all the reasons set out above, the Appellants’ application for stay of execution (Encl. 29) is dismissed. Costs are awarded to the Respondent in the sum of RM3,000.00.

judgments.title: MOHD NAZIR BIN ZARAAI v Pendakwa Raya
judgments.catchwords: PROSEDUR JENAYAH: Pertuduhan — Butiran mengenai masa — Tarikh kesalahan — Pertuduhan di bawah s. 14(a) Akta Kesalahan-Kesalahan Seksual Terhadap Kanak-Kanak 2017 dipinda kepada tempoh sebulan suntuk ("pada bulan Oktober 2021") — Sama ada tarikh kesalahan merupakan intipati penting — Tertuduh memajukan pembelaan alibi di bawah s. 402A Kanun Tatacara Jenayah — Sama ada peluasan garis masa memprejudiskan pembelaan alibi dan hak perlembagaan untuk mendapat perbicaraan yang adil di bawah perb. 5(1) Perlembagaan Persekutuan — Sama ada sabitan tidak selamat. KETERANGAN: Saksi — Kekompetenan dan kebolehpercayaan — Mangsa kanak-kanak kurang upaya intelektual (OKU Intelektual) — Ketiadaan penilaian klinikal atau psikiatri bebas bagi menilai keupayaan kognitif dan kerentanan terhadap pengaruh luar (coaching) — Keterangan lisan tanpa sokongan — Sama ada selamat untuk menyandarkan sabitan semata-mata atas keterangan saksi rentan. KETERANGAN: Kebolehpercayaan — Pembahagian kredibiliti (divisibility of credit) — Transaksi kejadian yang sama — Dakwaan utama rogol dan ugutan WhatsApp disangkal oleh bukti objektif laporan kimia (negatif DNA/air mani) dan laporan forensik telefon bimbit — Dakwaan sampingan amang seksual fizikal di bawah s. 14(a) Akta Kesalahan-Kesalahan Seksual Terhadap Kanak-Kanak 2017 — Sama ada kredibiliti saksi boleh dibelah bahagi dalam transaksi yang sama — Doktrin personaliti berkembar (split personality) — Sama ada tidak selamat untuk menerima saki-baki keterangan lisan mangsa. UNDANG-UNDANG JENAYAH: Akta Kesalahan-Kesalahan Seksual Terhadap Kanak-Kanak 2017 — Seksyen 14(a) — Amang seksual fizikal — Pertuduhan bertindih (duplicity) — Pertuduhan menggabungkan perbuatan memegang payudara dan mencium pipi dalam satu pertuduhan tunggal — Sama ada pertuduhan cacat di bawah s. 163 Kanun Tatacara Jenayah — Sama ada perbuatan fizikal membentuk satu transaksi rantaian yang berterusan. KETERANGAN: Keterangan sokongan (corroboration) — Keterangan perubatan — Penemuan koyakan lama selaput dara (old hymen tear) — Pakar mengesahkan koyakan boleh disebabkan oleh aktiviti fizikal lasak yang lain — Sama ada penemuan perubatan merupakan bukti sokongan bebas bagi kesalahan amang seksual fizikal. KETERANGAN: Anggapan memudaratkan — Kegagalan memanggil atau menawarkan saksi material — Ibu dan nenek mangsa yang mendengar aduan awal dan menemani mangsa ke hospital tidak dipanggil — Lompang keterangan dalam kes pendakwaan — Akta Keterangan 1950, s. 114(g). PROSEDUR JENAYAH: Rayuan — Rayuan bersilang — Rayuan tertuduh terhadap sabitan dan hukuman bersama rayuan silang pendakwaan bagi memperberat hukuman — Pembatalan sabitan dan pelepasan serta pembebasan penuh tertuduh — Kesan ke atas rayuan silang pendakwaan — Sama ada rayuan silang bertukar menjadi akademik.

judgments.title: SIVACHANDRAN A/L S JAYARAJAH v Pendakwa Raya
judgments.catchwords: Review jurisdiction - Rule 137 of the Rules of the Federal Court 1995 -Inherent powers of Federal Court – All sentences passed to be in accordance with the law – Avoiding miscarriage of justice - Exceptional circumstances - Fresh evidence of prisoner’s death following whipping. Constitutional Law - Federal Constitution - Articles 5(1), 8(1) and 8(2) Fundamental liberties - Life and personal liberty - Human dignity - Equal protection of the law - Whether it is in violation of medical ethics for medical officer to be participate in the execution of whipping. Judicial whipping - Corporal punishment - Whether judicial whipping amounts to cruel, inhuman and degrading treatment (“CIDT”) - Whether punishment of whipping is inconsistent with constitutional protection of life, dignity and bodily integrity. Whether whipping is disproportionate and therefore contrary to Article 8(1) - Whether exemption of women from whipping constitutes prohibited discrimination on ground only of gender is contrary to Art 8(2) - Intelligible differentia. Whether whipping is against Art. 5 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (“UDHR”) and the ASEAN Human Rights Declaration in its prohibitions against CIDT - Whether whipping is against customary international law.
